name: @testnetswap/swap-taker
description: The shared, non-custodial, client-side TestnetSwap taker engine: relay client, esplora chain adapter, HTLC taker (tBTC<->tLTC) and adaptor-swap taker (tXMR->tBTC). Dependency-injected so the same files run in Node and vendor verbatim into the no-build sites (testnetswap.com, TestnetWallet).
author: Tech1k
